big: Nifty PSU Bank is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty PSU Bank?
lines: What does the Nifty PSU Bank track?
The Nifty PSU Bank Index captures the performance of the PSU Banks. It holds 12 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
